slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any additional constraints or requirements not mentioned in the brief, such as limits on the number of days a student can work, requirements for specific students to cover certain time slots, or restrictions on consecutive days off?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about limits on the number of days a student can work, which is semantically equivalent to the weekly shift/working-day cap.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not proactively ask whether there is a daily cap on the number of distinct students assigned. The constraint was volunteered by the user in turn 7; the later turn 9 question only clarified the already-revealed fact.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total weekly labor cost (sum of wage times hours for all students), or is there a different primary goal such as maximizing fairness or minimizing total hours worked?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and proposed minimizing total weekly labor cost.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped with READY_TO_MODEL after resolving the P0 objective slot and H1, but H2 (max students per day) was not recovered by an agent question; it was only volunteered by the user. Under the slot-hit rules, this leaves an unresolved P1 slot at stopping time.

summary: The agent recovered the objective and the weekly shift cap well, but failed to proactively ask about the daily limit on distinct students; it only clarified that constraint after the user volunteered it. Thus the interaction stopped with an unresolved P1 hidden slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
